contents.text: How do I prove that an isolated pump can't start?
To prove that an isolated pump can't start, try to start the pump from the local panel. The local pressure gauges on the pump should read zero.

SOP-FS-007: Pump isolation and lockout
# SOP-FS-007: Pump isolation and lockout
This procedure isolates a pump so that it can't start, can't be pressurized and can't move while people work on it.
## Isolation steps
1. Tell the control room which pump you are isolating and why.
2. Stop the pump from the local panel and open the motor's isolator.
Everyone who works on the pump fits their own lock.
4. Close the suction and discharge valves and lock them closed.
5. Close the seal-water isolation valve upstream of the strainer and open the blow-down valve.
6. Open the casing drain and wait until it stops flowing.
7. Try to start the pump from the local panel to prove that it can't start, then return the switch to off.
8. Check that every pressure gauge on the pump reads zero.

Safety bulletin SB-0932: Seal housing work (Northgate plant) › Safety bulletin SB-0932: Seal housing work
Apply lockout/tagout (LOTO) to the motor and isolate the seal-water and process lines before opening any CP-200 seal housing.
Verify zero energy before work starts.
Zero energy means that the motor can't start from the panel, the local pressure gauges read zero and the casing drain is open.
Each person working on the pump fits their own lock.
At the Northgate plant, report any seal-water line that can't be isolated or drained to the Northgate maintenance planner on extension 5417 before work starts.

CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual › 5 Commissioning › 5.4 Start-up
## 5.4 Start-up
Before the first start, and after any work on the seal or the impeller, prime the pump and check the seal-water supply.
1. Open the suction valve fully.
Never throttle the suction side.
3. Open the seal-water supply and confirm a pressure of 2.0 to 3.0 bar at the seal flush connection.
4. Open the discharge valve about one quarter.
5. Jog the motor and confirm the direction of rotation against the arrow on the bearing housing.
6. Start the pump, then open the discharge valve slowly to the duty point within two minutes.
